v0.6 repair / qualification
---------------------------
- AIProviderAdapterBase and AIProviderRuntimeCapability use preferred non-virtual
  Alchemy Objects v0.7 INIT construction.
- Both common behavioural objects provide complete STANDARD adoption metadata:
  AUTHORSHIP, STANDARDS and DESIGN_LIMITATIONS.
- AlchemyAdoptionVerifier STANDARD passes with zero warnings.
- construction provenance entrypoint is INIT for both fixture objects.
- reserved Alchemy base override count is zero for both fixture objects.
- Runtime Registry qualification advanced to v0.14.
- optional WLU qualification advanced to v0.12 / work.load.units/0.12.
- public AI provider access API intentionally remains ai.provider.access/0.5;
  this release changes foundation/qualification, not provider request semantics.

Authority boundary retained
---------------------------
Plain provider request/reply/usage/tool/message values remain non-Alchemy DTOs.
Provider receives no Runtime Registry lifecycle authority, Ability session,
credential/broker authority, WLU account/rate-card/reservation authority or
provider dispatch authority merely through AIProviderRequest.
